<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>TechZone</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>:root{--bg:#333742;--sf:#454D5A;--dk:#191B20;--ac:#FDD14B;--rd:#ED5454;--t2:#A0B0BC;--mu:#787C85;--ol:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:#fff;font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
button,select,input{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac);outline-offset:2px}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.w{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.ic{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ic.f{fill:currentColor}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(25,27,32,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ol)}
.hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;height:68px}
.logo{font-weight:700;font-size:20px}.logo i{font-style:normal;color:var(--ac)}
.hd nav{display:flex;gap:26px;flex:1;font-size:14px;color:var(--t2)}
.hd nav a:hover,.hd nav button:hover{color:#fff}
.cb{position:relative;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--sf);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.bd{background:var(--ac);color:var(--dk);border-radius:9px;min-width:18px;height:18px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 5px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding:64px 0 48px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,56px);line-height:1.1;font-weight:700}
.hero p{color:var(--t2);margin:18px 0 28px;max-width:46ch}
.hero img{max-height:460px;margin:0 auto;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.cta{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--ac);color:var(--dk);border-radius:999px;padding:13px 28px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.cta:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}
.ghost{background:var(--sf);color:#fff}
h2{font-size:24px;font-weight:700}
.sec{padding:36px 0}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:20px}
.tile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--sf);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;text-align:left}
.tile img{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:15px}.tile span{color:var(--t2);font-size:12px}
.tool{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:20px 0}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--sf);color:var(--t2);font-size:13px}
.chip.on{background:#fff;color:var(--dk);font-weight:600}
.ctl{display:flex;gap:10px}
.ctl input,.ctl select{background:var(--sf);border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px}
.ctl select option{background:var(--dk)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:20px}
.pc{position:relative;background:var(--sf);border-radius:24px;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .2s}
.pc:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.pi{display:grid;place-items:center;height:210px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.pi img{max-height:180px;object-fit:contain}
.hb{position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(25,27,32,.6);display:grid;place-items:center}
.hb.on{color:var(--rd)}
.pb{padding:14px 4px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex:1}
.pb small{color:var(--t2);font-size:11px}
.pb h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.3}
.pr{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;margin:6px 0 12px}
.pr b{color:var(--ac);font-size:18px}.pr s{color:var(--mu);font-size:12px}
.add{margin-top:auto;background:var(--dk);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
.add:hover{background:var(--ac);color:var(--dk)}
.empty{color:var(--t2);padding:40px 0;grid-column:1/-1}
.bc{font-size:13px;color:var(--t2);padding:24px 0 8px}.bc a:hover{color:#fff}
.pd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:48px;padding:16px 0 48px}
.pm{background:var(--sf);border-radius:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:440px;padding:24px}
.pm img{max-height:400px;object-fit:contain}
.pd h1{font-size:34px;line-height:1.2;margin:6px 0}
.st{display:flex;gap:20px;color:var(--t2);font-size:13px;margin:12px 0 20px}.st span{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.big{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:20px}.big b{font-size:30px;color:var(--ac)}.big s{color:var(--mu)}
.lb{font-size:13px;color:var(--t2);margin:18px 0 8px}
.sw{display:flex;gap:10px}
.dot{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--ol)}.dot.on{border:2px solid #fff}
.row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.q{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--sf);border-radius:999px;padding:4px}
.q button{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center}.q button:hover{background:var(--dk)}.q em{min-width:24px;text-align:center;font-style:normal}
footer{margin-top:40px;background:var(--dk);padding:40px 0;color:var(--t2);font-size:13px}
.fg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px;justify-content:space-between}
footer b{color:#fff;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}footer a{display:block;padding:3px 0}footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.cp{border-top:1px solid var(--ol);margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;font-size:12px}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:30;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}
.ov.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
aside{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(400px,100%);background:var(--bg);z-index:31;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .25s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
aside.on{transform:none}
.ah{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ol)}
.al{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px 22px;display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
.ci{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:var(--sf);border-radius:16px;padding:10px}
.ci img{width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:contain}.ci b{font-size:13px;display:block}.ci span{color:var(--ac);font-size:13px}
.af{padding:20px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--ol)}
.af p{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}.af .cta{width:100%;justify-content:center}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:28px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:var(--dk);padding:12px 20px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:40;text-align:center;max-width:90%}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:860px){.hero,.pd{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:36px}.hd nav{display:none}.hd{justify-content:space-between}.pm{min-height:300px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
.ph{display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:90px;font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t2)}
.tile .ph{width:72px;height:72px;min-height:0;flex:none;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:12px;font-size:20px}
.ci .ph{width:60px;height:60px;min-height:0;font-size:16px}
.pm .ph{min-height:300px;font-size:64px}
.bl{color:var(--ac);text-decoration:underline}
.brands{max-width:520px}.brands a{display:inline-block;margin-right:16px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div>
<script>const D=[[1,'Sony','PlayStation 5','Consoles',27800],[2,'Sony','PlayStation 5 Digital Edition','Consoles',24750],[3,'Sony','DualSense Wireless Controller','Consoles',2200],[4,'Microsoft','Xbox Series X','Consoles',21500],[5,'Nintendo','Nintendo Switch OLED','Consoles',13500],
[6,'Apple','MacBook Pro 14" M4 Pro','Laptops',89999],[7,'Dell','XPS 15 9530','Laptops',62500],[8,'ASUS','ROG Zephyrus G14','Laptops',55000],[9,'Lenovo','ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12','Laptops',71000],[10,'HP','HP Spectre x360 14','Laptops',48000],
[11,'Apple','iPhone 16 Pro Max','Smartphones',42000],[12,'Samsung','Galaxy S25 Ultra','Smartphones',38500],[13,'Google','Pixel 9 Pro','Smartphones',28000],[14,'OnePlus','OnePlus 12','Smartphones',21000],[15,'Xiaomi','Xiaomi 14 Ultra','Smartphones',25500],
[16,'Sony','PULSE 3D Wireless Headset','Headphones',3150],[17,'Sony','WH-1000XM5','Headphones',8900],[18,'Apple','AirPods Pro 2nd Gen','Headphones',6200],[19,'Bose','QuietComfort Ultra','Headphones',11500],[20,'Samsung','Galaxy Buds3 Pro','Headphones',4800],
[21,'Apple','iPad Pro 13" M4','Tablets',52000],[22,'Samsung','Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra','Tablets',38000],[23,'Lenovo','Tab P12 Pro','Tablets',19500],
[24,'Sony','DualSense Charging Station','Accessories',950],[25,'Sony','PS5 Media Remote','Accessories',790],[26,'Logitech','MX Master 3S','Accessories',2800],[27,'Logitech','MX Keys S','Accessories',3200],[28,'Anker','PowerCore 26800 mAh','Accessories',1650],[29,'Samsung','65W Super Fast Charger','Accessories',850],[30,'Apple','MagSafe Charger 15W','Accessories',950],[31,'Dell','UltraSharp U2724D 27" Monitor','Accessories',14500],[32,'Meta','Meta Quest 3','Accessories',18000],[33,'Razer','Razer DeathAdder V3 HyperSpeed','Accessories',2100],[34,'SteelSeries','Arctis Nova Pro Wireless','Accessories',9800],[35,'Elgato','Stream Deck MK.2','Accessories',3900]];
const brandLinks={Sony:'https://www.sony.com',Microsoft:'https://www.xbox.com',Nintendo:'https://www.nintendo.com',Apple:'https://www.apple.com',Dell:'https://www.dell.com',ASUS:'https://www.asus.com',Lenovo:'https://www.lenovo.com',HP:'https://www.hp.com',Samsung:'https://www.samsung.com',Google:'https://store.google.com',OnePlus:'https://www.oneplus.com',Xiaomi:'https://www.mi.com',Bose:'https://www.bose.com',Logitech:'https://www.logitech.com',Anker:'https://www.anker.com',Meta:'https://www.meta.com',Razer:'https://www.razer.com',SteelSeries:'https://steelseries.com',Elgato:'https://www.elgato.com'};
const IMG={"1": "data:image/webp;base64,", "2": "data:image/webp;base64,", "3": "data:image/webp;base64,", "16": "data:image/webp;base64,", "24": "data:image/webp;base64,", "25": "data:image/webp;base64,"};
const P=D.map(([id,brand,name,cat,price])=>({id:String(id),brand,name,cat,price,img:IMG[id]||`assets/images/${id}.png`}));
const I={x:'<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/>',menu:'<path d="M4 9h16M4 15h16"/>',bell:'<path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0"/>',search:'<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/>',sliders:'<path d="M4 6h10M18 6h2M4 12h4M12 12h8M4 18h12M20 18h0"/><circle cx="16" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="10" cy="12" r="2"/><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2"/>',heart:'<path d="M20.8 4.6a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 0L12 5.7l-1-1.1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 7.8l1 1.1L12 21.2l7.8-7.7 1-1.1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.8z"/>',eye:'<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8S1 12 1 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>',bag:'<path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4zM3 6h18M16 10a4 4 0 0 1-8 0"/>',user:'<path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>',home:'<path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2zM9 22V12h6v10"/>',back:'<path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6"/>',plus:'<path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>',minus:'<path d="M5 12h14"/>'};
const ic=(n,f)=>`<svg class="ic${f?' f':''}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${I[n]}</svg>`;
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const ld=(k,d)=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))??d}catch{return d}};
const sv=(k,v)=>{try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch{}};
const esc=s=>s.replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const S={cat:'All',q:'',sort:'feat',color:0,qty:1,open:false,fav:ld('tz.fav',[]),cart:ld('tz.cart',{})};
const cats=[...new Set(P.map(p=>p.cat))];
const money=v=>'EGP '+v.toLocaleString('en-US');
const count=()=>Object.values(S.cart).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const find=id=>P.find(p=>p.id===id);
const vis=()=>{let r=P.filter(p=>(S.cat==='All'||(S.cat==='Saved'?S.fav.includes(p.id):p.cat===S.cat))&&p.name.toLowerCase().includes(S.q.trim().toLowerCase()));
if(S.sort==='lo')r.sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);if(S.sort==='hi')r.sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price);if(S.sort==='az')r.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));return r};
const heart=p=>`<button class="hb${S.fav.includes(p.id)?' on':''}" data-act="fav" data-id="${p.id}" aria-label="Save ${p.name}">${ic('heart',S.fav.includes(p.id))}</button>`;
const card=p=>`<article class="pc">${heart(p)}<a class="pi" href="#/product/${p.id}"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy"></a><div class="pb"><small>${p.brand} · ${p.cat}</small><h3><a href="#/product/${p.id}">${p.name}</a></h3><div class="pr"><b>${money(p.price)}</b>${p.old?`<s>${money(p.old)}</s>`:''}</div><button class="add" data-act="add" data-id="${p.id}">${ic('bag')}Add to cart</button></div></article>`;
const gridHTML=()=>vis().map(card).join('')||`<p class="empty">${S.cat==='Saved'&&!S.q?'No saved products yet. Tap a heart to save one.':'No products match your search.'}</p>`;
const header=()=>`<header><div class="w hd"><a class="logo" href="#/">Tech<i>Zone</i></a><nav><a href="#/">Home</a><button data-act="shop">Shop</button><button data-act="saved">Saved (${S.fav.length})</button></nav><button class="cb" data-act="drawer" aria-label="Open cart">${ic('bag')}Cart${count()?`<span class="bd">${count()}</span>`:''}</button></div></header>`;
const home=()=>{const h=find('1');return `<section class="w hero"><div><h1>PlayStation 5 and gear, all in one place</h1><p>Consoles, controllers, headsets and accessories. Compare options and add what you need in a few taps.</p><a class="cta" href="#/product/1">View PS5 · ${money(h.price)}</a> <button class="cta ghost" data-act="shop">Browse all</button></div><img src="${h.img}" alt="Playstation 5 with controller"></section>
<section class="w sec"><h2>Shop by category</h2><div class="tiles">${cats.map(c=>{const ps=P.filter(p=>p.cat===c);return `<button class="tile" data-act="cat" data-v="${c}"><img src="${ps[0].img}" alt="${c}"><div><b>${c}</b><span>${ps.length} product${ps.length>1?'s':''}</span></div></button>`}).join('')}</div></section>
<section class="w sec" id="shop"><h2>Products</h2><div class="tool"><div class="chips">${['All','Saved',...cats].map(c=>`<button class="chip${c===S.cat?' on':''}" data-act="cat" data-v="${c}">${c}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="ctl"><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search products" value="${esc(S.q)}" aria-label="Search products"><select id="sort" aria-label="Sort products">${[['feat','Featured'],['lo','Price: low to high'],['hi','Price: high to low'],['az','Name: A to Z']].map(([v,l])=>`<option value="${v}"${S.sort===v?' selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="grid" id="grid">${gridHTML()}</div></section>`};
const detail=id=>{const p=find(id);if(!p)return `<div class="w sec"><h2>Product not found</h2><p class="empty">Go back to <a href="#/">the shop</a>.</p></div>`;const f=S.fav.includes(p.id);return `<div class="w"><div class="bc"><a href="#/">Home</a> / ${p.cat} / ${p.name}</div><div class="pd"><div class="pm"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}"></div><div><small style="color:var(--t2)">${p.brand} · ${p.cat}</small><h1>${p.name}</h1><div class="big"><b>${money(p.price)}</b>${p.old?`<s>${money(p.old)}</s>`:''}</div><p class="lb">Brand: <a class="bl" href="${brandLinks[p.brand]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${p.brand} website</a></p><div class="row"><div class="q"><button data-act="qm" aria-label="Less">${ic('minus')}</button><em>${S.qty}</em><button data-act="qp" aria-label="More">${ic('plus')}</button></div><button class="cta" data-act="addq" data-id="${p.id}">${ic('bag')}Add to cart</button><button class="cta ghost" data-act="fav" data-id="${p.id}">${ic('heart',f)}${f?'Saved':'Save'}</button></div></div></div>
<section class="sec"><h2>You may also like</h2><div class="grid" style="margin-top:20px">${P.filter(x=>x.id!==id).slice(0,4).map(card).join('')}</div></section></div>`};
const drawer=()=>{const ids=Object.keys(S.cart).filter(id=>find(id));const total=ids.reduce((s,id)=>s+find(id).price*S.cart[id],0);return `<div class="ov${S.open?' on':''}" data-act="drawer"></div><aside class="${S.open?'on':''}" aria-label="Cart" ${S.open?'':'inert'}><div class="ah"><h2>Your cart</h2><button data-act="drawer" aria-label="Close cart">${ic('x')}</button></div><div class="al">${ids.length?ids.map(id=>{const p=find(id);return `<div class="ci"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}"><div><b>${p.name}</b><span>${money(p.price)}</span></div><div class="q"><button data-act="dec" data-id="${id}" aria-label="Remove one">${ic('minus')}</button><em>${S.cart[id]}</em><button data-act="inc" data-id="${id}" aria-label="Add one">${ic('plus')}</button></div></div>`}).join(''):'<p class="empty">Your cart is empty.</p>'}</div>${ids.length?`<div class="af"><p><span>Subtotal</span><b>${money(total)}</b></p><button class="cta" data-act="checkout">Checkout</button></div>`:''}</aside>`};
const footer=()=>`<footer><div class="w"><div class="fg"><div><b>TechZone</b>Gaming and electronics demo store.</div><div><b>Shop</b>${cats.map(c=>`<a href="#/" data-act="cat" data-v="${c}">${c}</a>`).join('')}</div><div class="brands"><b>Brands</b>${Object.entries(brandLinks).map(([b,u])=>`<a href="${u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${b}</a>`).join("")}</div></div><div class="cp">Store design based on the free Electronics E-Commerce App UI by Heba Zatar (personal use). Demo project: no real orders or payments.</div></div></footer>`;
function render(){const m=location.hash.match(/^#\/product\/(\w+)/);$('#app').innerHTML=header()+`<main>${m?detail(m[1]):home()}</main>`+footer()+drawer()}
let tm;function toast(m){clearTimeout(tm);let t=$('#toast');if(!t){t=document.createElement('div');t.id='toast';t.setAttribute('role','status');document.body.appendChild(t)}t.textContent=m;t.className='show';tm=setTimeout(()=>t.className='',2400)}
const save=()=>sv('tz.cart',S.cart);
const home_=()=>{if(location.hash.startsWith('#/product'))location.hash='#/';else render()};
const toShop=()=>setTimeout(()=>$('#shop')?.scrollIntoView(),0);
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-act]');if(!t)return;const a=t.dataset.act,id=t.dataset.id,v=t.dataset.v;
if(a==='cat'){S.cat=v;home_();toShop()}
else if(a==='shop'){S.cat='All';home_();toShop()}
else if(a==='saved'){S.cat='Saved';home_();toShop()}
else if(a==='fav'){e.preventDefault();S.fav=S.fav.includes(id)?S.fav.filter(x=>x!==id):[...S.fav,id];sv('tz.fav',S.fav);render()}
else if(a==='color'){S.color=+v;render()}
else if(a==='qm'){S.qty=Math.max(1,S.qty-1);render()}
else if(a==='qp'){S.qty=Math.min(10,S.qty+1);render()}
else if(a==='add'){S.cart[id]=(S.cart[id]||0)+1;save();render();toast('Added to cart')}
else if(a==='addq'){S.cart[id]=(S.cart[id]||0)+S.qty;save();S.qty=1;S.open=true;render()}
else if(a==='inc'){S.cart[id]++;save();render()}
else if(a==='dec'){if(--S.cart[id]<1)delete S.cart[id];save();render()}
else if(a==='drawer'){S.open=!S.open;render()}
else if(a==='checkout'){toast('Checkout is not available in this demo. No payment is taken.')}});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='q'){S.q=e.target.value;$('#grid').innerHTML=gridHTML()}});
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.id==='sort'){S.sort=e.target.value;$('#grid').innerHTML=gridHTML()}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&S.open){S.open=false;render()}});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{S.color=0;S.qty=1;render();if(!location.hash.startsWith('#/product')&&!S.keep)scrollTo(0,0);else scrollTo(0,0)});
document.addEventListener('error',e=>{const i=e.target;if(i.tagName!=='IMG')return;const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='ph';d.textContent=(i.alt||'?').trim().slice(0,2).toUpperCase();i.replaceWith(d)},true);
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
